game_title: Key Vault – Cloud Sea Overlook Race
game_concept: A racing platformer set in Frost Peaks – Cloud Sea Overlook, an overlook above the clouds: the avalanche scout must handle yetis while practicing strings & dictionaries. Core idea – Key Vault: Look up values in a dictionary by key to open the pass gate.
theme: Frost Peaks – Cloud Sea Overlook: an overlook above the clouds
core_gameplay_loop: In Cloud Sea Overlook, repeat each round: Look up values in a dictionary by key to open the pass gate. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the avalanche scout ahead. Then check the vault_keys value and advance.
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the pass gate by solving code steps involving vault_keys that move the avalanche scout forward.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.65).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the pass gate first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 8 – Strings & Dictionaries | Level 4 (applied tier): Key Vault
assets_style: towering pixel-art mountains: glaciers, jagged ice ridges, crisp white and cyan with deep blue shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Key Vault' (Week 8 slot 7), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Cloud Sea Overlook'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Frost Peaks
region.mood: thin howling wind, high strings and ice-crack stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how vault_keys changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against yetis in Cloud Sea Overlook.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.65).
